_note: Upcoming community meetings and neighborhood-group events shown in the carve-out box on the homepage front page. Civic meetings come from the 34th Ward newsletter (Conway's Corner), the West Central Association and West Loop Community Organization newsletters, and the CCPSA public meeting calendar (ccpsa.chicago.gov/public-meeting-calendar, which lists the 1st and 12th District Council meetings); the Indivisible Greater West Loop events come from that chapter's Mobilize page (mobilize.us/indivisiblegwlchi). Optional fields: 'org' (a small source label) and 'url' (makes the title a link). Exact venues for the Indivisible events are gated behind RSVP, so 'location' is only filled where publicly verified and the link carries the rest. The homepage shows only future-dated items, soonest first, and drops them once they pass. Refresh Indivisible events from their Mobilize page. Indivisible's own calendar is the Teamup agenda embedded on indivisiblegwlchi.org (teamup.com/ks9bd5wmfv7ks27vmy, has venues); it lists IGWL events plus partner Indivisible Chicago canvasses and phone banks. Dan's rule (2026-10-21): this is a community hub, publish every verified event we know about.
